hooks: I stood on my porch at 3:12 to see what it saw.
The figure on my porch was never watching the street.
At 3:12 my phone chimed, and my front door was open.
I finally learned who rings my doorbell at 3:12.
A second figure stepped out of my own front door.
closing_line: Listen to the full story on the channel, from the first ping.
